flavor.phonemic_palette: Norse for the elite register (nominative -r; th/dh; -son; konungr/jarl) over a Slavic substrate for land and commons (palatalization; sibilants; -ov/-ich; gorod/reka); theophoric stratified (Norse Orlund-/Nymir- for the elite, Slavic Goyan-/Relata- for the commons).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Norse + Slavic per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Norse + Slavic register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'rovan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Rovan — tolerant feudal of the taiga; strength, wealth.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Rovan (Norse + Slavic) are a assertive feudal people seeded in taiga, forest, tundra. They prize strength, wealth, freedom, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, marines, archers. Outsiders are met as tolerant; their patrons touch trade, war, storms.
